title: Windows 10 devices remain in the estate

messages.businessImpact: Windows 10 has reached the end of mainstream support, so these devices receive no security updates unless extended support has been purchased separately.
remediation: Establish which devices can upgrade in place and which need replacing on hardware grounds.
Where extended security updates have been bought, record that and treat this finding as informational.
messages.cannotSee: Windows 10 is read from the build number the device last reported. A device that has not checked in since it was upgraded still reads as Windows 10 here, and a device whose version Graph did not return is not counted at all.
